newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks seen rising further.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks seen rising further.

text.p: Share prices on the Caracas Stock Exchange were expected to rise to record highs once again on Thursday as brokers reported unfilled buy orders.
"The signs are good, I think the bolsa will continue to rise," said Cavelba broker Harold Cuellar.

Gains today would take the bolsa's string of consecutive record-breaking sessions to 10. On Wednesday the market's 19-share .IBC index closed up 6.62 percent at 5,920.00. Some 59 million shares worth 8.8 billion bolivars ($19 million) changed hands.
The recent appreciation of the local currency, falling inflation and the prospect of new issues through privatizations are behind the market's continued optimism, brokers said.
